description.value:
Berserk activates as half of a ROF2 Action and lasts 5 Rounds. Without an FBC or Cyberspine, −4 to ranged attacks while it runs. While it runs: your limbs count as cyberlimbs for damaging Steel cover and for falls; Mortally Wounded no longer gives you automatic Critical Injuries; all damage is 2 less before armor; and your first Brawling, Martial Arts or melee hit each Round adds +1 damage per point of BODY above 10. 1-hour cooldown, or reactivate early for 3 Humanity Loss, then 6, then 9.

Runs: Berserk

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
